The '''Gedi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was made up of five [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]], including [[Gedi 4]], orbiting a [[Binary star/Legends|double star]].<ref name="Atlas" />
